title: Intelligent Ticket Routing
story: As a fulfiller, I want tickets created by the assistant to be routed automatically to the correct team, so that manual reassignment is minimized.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a ticket matches configured routing keywords
acceptanceCriteria.then: it is assigned to the corresponding resolver queue

acceptanceCriteria.given: multiple routing rules match a ticket
acceptanceCriteria.when: the routing engine processes the ticket

acceptanceCriteria.given: no routing rule matches a ticket
acceptanceCriteria.when: the routing engine processes the ticket
acceptanceCriteria.then: it is assigned to the default queue

acceptanceCriteria.given: a ticket is routed by the AI
acceptanceCriteria.then: the routing decision and reason are visible

edgeCases: Routing rule configuration changes while ticket is being created
Default queue is full or disabled
Ticket content matches a deprecated routing keyword
Re-routing after category override by fulfiller
